name: Banshee
description: The Banshee was a Lancer-class pursuit craft which served as the personal starship of bounty hunter Asajj Ventress during the Clone Wars. The Banshee featured two cabins, a small galley, and a cargo hold, used for holding bounties prisoner.

data.name: Banshee
data.destroyed: 19 BBY, during the second battle of Christophsis
